title: President Trump set to deliver first State of the Union address of his second term
summary: Facing low approval ratings and ahead of midterm elections in November, President Trump delivers the first State of the Union address of his second term as president Tuesday night.
contentText:
Facing low approval ratings and ahead of midterm elections in November, President Trump delivers the first State of the Union address of his second term as president Tuesday night.

(Image credit: Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)
